rationale: Both Micah and Lydia are deep in the developer tools and visual communication space — Micah built visual intuition for ML systems at H2O.ai and is now founding IntentiveAI around interactive data visualization, while Lydia leads developer experience at Anthropic's Claude Code team and is known for making complex technical concepts accessible through visual content. They share conviction that great tooling and clear communication unlock adoption, and could explore how visual interfaces and developer-focused education apply to agentic AI tooling.
intro_message: Micah Stubbs, meet Lydia Hallie — you both believe visual communication and developer experience are force-multipliers for AI adoption, and could compare notes on making cutting-edge tooling (visual ML interfaces vs. agentic coding) actually intuitive to use.
